streams.label: Recycling
streams.description: Clean paper, cardboard, plastic bottles (#1 and #2 only at this office), metal cans, glass.

streams.label: Compost
streams.description: Food scraps, coffee grounds, tea bags, soiled paper napkins, BPI-certified compostable cups and containers.

streams.label: Landfill
streams.description: Chip bags, candy wrappers, styrofoam, plastic wrap, non-compostable cups, straws, mixed packaging.

streams.label: E-Waste Bin
streams.description: Old cables, chargers, USB devices, small electronics, batteries, phone accessories. Drop in the purple e-waste bin by the elevator.

streams.label: Facilities Pickup
streams.description: Toner cartridges, large electronics, fluorescent bulbs, chemicals. Email facilities@company.com or leave by the loading dock.

streams.label: Needs Verification
streams.description: Items that cannot be confidently classified. Please ask facilities staff or check the posted signage near the bins.

overrides.note: This office uses BPI-certified compostable cups. Check for the green compostable logo on the bottom.
K-Cup pods are mixed materials. This office does not have a pod recycling program.
Plastic bags jam sorting machinery. Use the bag collection box by reception instead.
Flatten cardboard and place next to the recycling bin if it doesn't fit inside.
Drop batteries in the purple e-waste bin by the elevator. Never put batteries in regular bins.
Old cables and chargers go in the purple e-waste bin by the elevator.
Old chargers go in the purple e-waste bin by the elevator.
USB devices and cables go in the purple e-waste bin.
Old headphones go in the purple e-waste bin by the elevator.
Used paper napkins and tissues are compostable.
This office uses compostable utensils. Check for the BPI logo.

siteRules.instruction: Toner cartridges are collected by facilities. Leave on the shelf by the copy room, do not put in any bin.
Printer cartridges are collected by facilities. Leave on the shelf by the copy room.
Monitors and large electronics require a facilities pickup. Email facilities@company.com.
Laptops must go through IT asset disposal. Contact IT, do not place in any waste bin.
Plastic #5 (PP) is not accepted in recycling at this office. Place in landfill.
Polypropylene containers are not recyclable at this location. Place in landfill.
